verdict.rationale: Modal's marketing states that sandboxes are billed "by the second with no reserved capacity" (modal-docs-5, modal-docs-16). The pricing page says "Only pay for what you use" and lets you burst without pre-allocating CPU or memory (modal-docs-7, modal-docs-17). One community builder also reports paying only for what they need on Modal Sandboxes (modal-comm-1). Missing for 10: detailed billing docs with per-second CPU/memory rates for sandboxes, clarity on whether billing tracks actual usage or requested resources (and idle time), and independent hands-on verification of billing granularity.
